name: Kennel
subtitle: where the doghouse is the moon
story: On Kennel, the doghouse is the moon. Forget a birthday or an anniversary and you spend the night up there, with a camp bed, a kettle and the best view in the system. On a bad night, half the street is up there. Dean forgot his and Emma's anniversary, and up he went. At midnight, Emma went up too. She took the cake. Best anniversary they've had.
hook: A planet for whoever forgot the anniversary.
cover: At midnight, Emma went up too.

beats.note: identical camera to Dean's beat; Emma rises off the ledge towards the moon, the window stays lit. Turn line

episode.caption:
There's a spare room in that moon.

Kennel: 1.2 million people, a 25-hour day, one very large moon, and nowhere on the ground to sulk. Forget a birthday or an anniversary here and you spend the night on the moon. It's not unpleasant: there's a camp bed, a kettle and the best view in the system, and the lift runs late. On a bad night, half the street is up there. Dean forgot his and Emma's anniversary.

I missed my editor's birthday. The moon is lovely this time of year.

(The story goes that 'in the doghouse' owes a lot to Peter Pan, where Mr Darling moves into the dog's kennel to make amends. On Kennel, the kennel has a view.)

What would get you sent to the moon?

first_comment: They came down on Sunday. Dean's put the date in his phone, his diary and the fridge.
